description.value: The YMCA-YWCA Downtown Victoria is a full-service community fitness and recreation centre operated by the YMCA-YWCA of Vancouver Island, offering pool and aquatics, fitness programs, and community health services in the heart of downtown. It is one of two YMCA facilities on Vancouver Island and offers a 'Member for a Day' option that allows drop-in visitors to access facilities without a full membership. As a non-profit with financial assistance programs, it functions as an accessible community hub for both residents and visitors.

The phone number on the website (250-386-7511) matches OSM. However, none of the cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, water bottle refill, showers—are explicitly described in the fetched website content, so all amenity fields default to null per evidence rules.
